candidateDispositions.rationale: The analyzer names the forbidden alias category, while ProductionTimeProvider maps operating-system time-zone identifiers with live lookup consumers; neither is an API compatibility alias.
SerialPortAdapter is the NModbus transport object constructed by the live RTU master path, not a compatibility wrapper owned by Edge.
The word occurs only in the diagnostic that prevents deleted wrappers from being reintroduced; the analyzer consumes that descriptor.
Active host-API and release-version compatibility policies reject incompatible packages and expose current diagnostics; they are the primary contract, not an alternate legacy path.
The remaining legacy markers read installed historical config, cache, signal, or password data and immediately project or rewrite the current format; new writers and new consumers are forbidden.
candidateDispositions.producer: Installed pre-current Edge configuration, device-session cache, module signal metadata, and SHA-256 password records
currentConsumers: schema reconciliation of installed module/IO metadata
candidateDispositions.replacementPath: All current writes use the canonical system switch, ClientCode-keyed cache, explicit signal contract, and PBKDF2 password format.
candidateDispositions.deletionCondition: Supported deployed estates contain no pre-current records for one full release window and migration telemetry confirms zero reads.
